title: The LOVE headstand: your legs make the V between big wall letters
summary: You go upside down in front of the letters L, O and E, open your legs into a V, and the wall spells LOVE. No real headstand needed.
why: AI Trend Club lists a LOVE handstand trend traced to a TikTok post from November 14, 2026. A November 21 check counted about 13.6M views and 1.6M likes on the original. A person holds a headstand in front of the letters L, O and E and opens their legs into the V. People now make it from one photo with AI, so anyone can do the pose. We haven't covered it before.
steps: Pick a clear, full-body photo of yourself in comfy clothes you can move in.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool with your photo.
Check the letters read L, O, then the V, then E from left to right. Regenerate if they shuffle.
Post it and say it's made with AI.

prompts.label: Main prompt: plain room, LOVE on the wall
prompts.text: Use the adult in this photo. Keep their face, hair, body and clothes exactly the same. Make a 12-second vertical clip with a fixed camera in a plain, bright room with a soft carpet. On the wall behind them are three large red letters, left to right: L, O, a wide empty gap, then E. Seconds 0 to 3: the person stands in the gap, smiles and places their hands and head on the carpet. Seconds 3 to 7: they rise slowly into a steady headstand, legs together, pointing straight up. Seconds 7 to 10: they open their legs into a wide V, so the wall now reads LOVE with their legs as the V. They hold it still. Seconds 10 to 12: they bring their legs together and come down gently, then sit and grin at the camera. Smooth, realistic motion. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: holiday living room
prompts.text: Use the adult in this photo. Keep their face and features the same. Make a 12-second vertical clip with a fixed camera in a cosy living room with a decorated tree in the corner and warm string lights. Large gold letters on the wall read, left to right: L, O, a wide gap, then E. The person, in matching holiday pyjamas, goes into a calm headstand in the gap and opens their legs into a V so the wall spells LOVE. They hold it for two seconds, then roll down and laugh. Warm evening light. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: the wobbly try
prompts.text: Use the adult in this photo. Keep their face and features the same. Make a 10-second vertical clip with a fixed camera in a plain room with large red letters on the wall: L, O, a wide gap, then E. The person goes into a headstand in the gap and opens their legs into a V to spell LOVE. They hold it for one second, wobble, and tip slowly sideways onto a big soft cushion. They lie there giving a thumbs up to the camera. Gentle, funny, nobody gets hurt. No other text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: yoga or fitness studio
prompts.text: Use this photo of our instructor [upload]. Keep their face exactly the same. Make a 12-second vertical clip with a fixed camera in a bright studio with wooden floors and mats. Large letters on the wall read, left to right: L, O, a wide gap, then E. The instructor rolls out a mat in the gap, goes into a steady headstand and opens their legs into a V so the wall spells LOVE. They hold it, come down smoothly and wave the camera in. Calm, clean light. No other text, no logos or brand names.

tips: Spell out the letter order and the gap in your prompt. AI tools often mix up letters on walls.
A fixed camera keeps the word lined up. Ask for it every time.
Don't try a real headstand for the clip unless you've trained for it. That's what the AI is for.
Only use photos of adults who said yes, and say it's made with AI.
